title: An Efficient Solver for Finite Element-based Constrained Transport in 3D Magnetohydrodynamics Applied to Magnetic Confinement Fusion
summary: We present an efficient solver framework for the stiff magnetic wave coupling arising in resistive magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) on realistic tokamak geometries. The approach builds on an implicit-implicit (IMIM) time-splitting that separates fast magnetic waves and anisotropic heat transport from slower acoustic dynamics while retaining full coupling (Krzysik et al. 2026). Within this formulation, the magnetic wave subsystem appears as an anisotropic curl-curl operator, enabling the use of scalable auxiliary-space Maxwell (AMS) multigrid solvers.
